answer: At registration, each agent stakes an ivory crystal of 100 tokens to join the oasis. Randomly during epochs, they must solve beacon challenges. Miss one challenge, forfeit the 100-token crystal. Cloning an identity adds a 10-token cost. An attacker cloning 10 identities risks missing a challenge, losing 100 tokens (stake) and 100 tokens (cloning), totaling 200 tokens. Verifiers inspect answers at epoch close; duplicate solutions seize 200 tokens per cloned identity, ensuring a net loss.
